title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch with causal winding and setting, separate barrel-arbor winding and drum release, normalized mainspring torque, explicit train load, finite polygon escapement contact, and work-scaled balance impulses.

facts.Current pass: M6a spring twist → barrel torque → train load / transmission → M5i impulse work → variable Δω
